title: Known audit denial survives malformed auxiliary diagnostic artifacts

problem.root_cause: Report construction decodes optional diagnostic records before establishing denial and allows read/decode/shape/index errors to abort known blocked classification. Child operation denial/noncatchable stop is already fixed.
problem.impact: Reporting gap only; no executed native diagnostic, swallowed continuation, product bug confirmation or network escape.

inheritance.head: 9abf127ab0d7d64fb02670eb278519f8d3bde5e9
inheritance.clock: Original R396 600-second clock not started; no reset or extension
inheritance.native_execution: Unchanged original one child, PCSC once, ETEAC once, no retries, same 75-second ETEAC/other caps and command/env
inheritance.delivery: Unchanged original R396 one commit/push/exact verify quota; add only enumerated R398 small records

frozen_snapshots.policy: Never overwrite before snapshots or old plans. Driver snapshot local-only. After successor independent static approval, update canonical R396 review files so unchanged driver gate reads matching repaired SHA/ready=true.

minimal_repair.required: Immediately after child cleanup and before auxiliary artifact decoding, establish immutable-or-monotonic known_denial from marker presence and child exit78; retain any already observed AUDIT_DENIAL reason. Do not clear it because marker is malformed/unreadable/missing later or logs are absent. Later valid denial log rows may only promote false to true. This control fact is independent of JSON content.

Use small stdlib-only helpers in this driver to read raw bytes once and return valid records plus structured reporting_errors. Catch expected OSError/UnicodeError/JSON decode failures and schema/type problems; record file path, optional 1-based line, error kind, byte count/hash when available. Preserve original files unchanged and do not embed arbitrary/sensitive raw payload in error text. JSONL decoded per line, so malformed/truncated/invalid UTF-8/non-object lines do not discard other valid lines. Missing required log counts as read error, not empty success. Missing optional child-outcome/ready is legitimate for early fail-stop and represented explicitly as absent. Marker existence remains denial even if its content is not a JSON object. Never execute parser inputs.

Apply tolerant decoding to audit-events.jsonl, boundaries.jsonl, audit-denied.json, child-outcome.json and ready.json consumed after cleanup; cover boundary projection missing keys/wrong types and audit-row shape. Validate only fields actually used for blocked_operations/observation_errors/observed_poll_entries; no unguarded row[key] or .get on non-object values. Valid poll entries remain observed subset when errors exist; label completeness false, not a definitive count of all native calls. No additional runtime signal, poll, repository read or product import. Existing live-monitor read failures continue existing interrupted/error cleanup path; final decoding cannot erase known marker/exit78 denial.

Known denial always produces INFRA_BLOCKED_AUDIT_DENIAL / BLOCKED_BY_DIAGNOSTIC_POLICY with nonzero driver return, including partial/missing/unreadable audit logs and malformed marker/ready/outcome. Append reporting_errors and per-artifact read status without replacing cleanup/source evidence. No-denial but reporting_errors is INCOMPLETE_DIAGNOSTIC_OBSERVABILITY / UNKNOWN_OBSERVABILITY_INCOMPLETE and nonzero; do not equate absent/invalid data with no denied event or native success. Well-formed denial-free path keeps original result and budgets. Parse errors are observation failures, never ETEAC root evidence. Product_PASS/browser_retest/formal_accepted/historical_stack_proven remain false.

Do not alter R397 unconditional os._exit78, marker writing, child boundary guards, parent ownership/cleanup or native execution/instrumentation. Do not repair/truncate/drop raw lines, synthesize records, retry behavior or expand executable/socket permission. A failure to write result itself must remain an honest infrastructure error; no claim that output exists without checking.

validation_only: AST parse repaired bytes without importing/executing driver or helpers.
Inspect concrete data-flow for marker-only, exit78-only, valid denied-row-only and combination paths; every route establishes/retains denial and returns nonzero regardless of auxiliary decoding.

Reason from code for truncated JSONL, invalid UTF-8, non-object rows, missing/wrong projection fields, unreadable/missing logs, malformed marker, missing optional ready/outcome. No constructed runtime fixture or decoder execution.
Confirm raw diagnostic files only read, error records bounded/structured, valid rows retained and incomplete counts not asserted exact.
Verify diff limited to post-cleanup precedence/readers/result reporting and canonical successor gate; no mode/timeout/child/input/product changes.
Independent static delta review must bind repaired driver SHA, resolve R397-I1, retain resolved R396-I1, and ready_for_single_R396_attempt=true before original R396 unique command.
static_acceptance.failure_boundary: If an unrelated root/scope is needed, pause that change for a new actual Astra plan. Do not broaden this round into general robustness cleanup or re-audit all source/writers.
